best_idea: A guild-owned instance of one hall zone, found again by a stored id and expired by a stored time, with a two-stage deposit-then-promote storage whose slots are capped, permissioned per slot, and refused by a fixed anti-dupe list.
decision_why: Keep the guild-instance join and the deposit-to-main promote; drive expiry from ledger upkeep rows and make the cap and free-slot test server constants. Reject the bucket-based expiry and the client-version cap.
acceptance: Two members of one guild open the hall from a phone and see the same instance; a member's deposit shows as banker-only in the deposit tab; a non-banker promote is refused; a 41st deposit is refused with the area-full message; a server test asserts all four.
